items.html: And the matter of the straps is the aspect of the drawing of the four Mochin below. And it is known that the four Mochin were clothed in the NHY of Ima, as above. And they are divided into two parts, right and left, and their division is as follows: in the aspect of the NHY of Ima, the Yesod includes the two coronets of Daat, which are Hassadim and Gevurot.
